mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_card (card_id, user_id, type, status, next_due_at, front, back, source_analysis_id, source_ref, evidence_json) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{nextDueAt}, #{front}, #{back}, #{sourceAnalysisId}, #{sourceRef}, #{evidenceJson})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM growth_card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status <> 'mastered' AND next_due_at IS NOT NULL AND next_due_at <= #{today} ORDER BY next_due_at ASC
